0022600165.text: The New Orleans Pelicans (2-4, 0-2 on the road) sit 11th in the West and 4 games back in fifth place in the Southwest as they visit the Memphis Grizzlies (6-0), who lead the West and are on a six-game winning streak. The teams split their 2025-26 series 2-2, the Pelicans won the most recent meeting 114-106 in New Orleans, and they have not met yet this season. New Orleans is without Yves Missi (out, knee bruise) and has Dejounte Murray (personal) and Jordan Poole (ankle sprain) listed as day-to-day, while Memphis has Quinten Post (ankle), Scotty Pippen Jr., and Ty Jerome (both back soreness) listed as day-to-day.
